name: POST /api/leadflow/sequences/nurture - enter a record on the track its REASON dictates
description:
Places a record on the nurture track its reason dictates (0a3474c3-56f8-4af6-8931-eb27cfddc13c#AC1), and creates the first dated touch so the record never sits without a next action (0a3474c3-56f8-4af6-8931-eb27cfddc13c#AC2).

AN OWNER IS REQUIRED, not defaulted to nobody. A nurture record with no owner never comes back, so the column is NOT NULL and the handler refuses without one.

A NO-FIT RECORD IS NOT NURTURED WITHOUT A SPECIFIC FUTURE CHANGE (0a3474c3-56f8-4af6-8931-eb27cfddc13c#AC4). SOP §47 is explicit, and the reason is that nurturing somebody who will never fit is a cost to them and to us forever. VERIFIED LIVE: no_fit_today with no future_change returned 400 naming the rule, and a CHECK constraint refuses it at the database so no other writer can store one.

THE FIRST TOUCH IS DATED FROM THE TRACK, so entering a record immediately produces the dated NEXT the invariant requires rather than leaving a gap until somebody runs a sweep. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A no-fit record with no named future change is refused
NEGATIVE: an unknown reason segment is refused
NEGATIVE: no owner, so the record would never come back
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: reason_segment must be one of timing_or_season, budget_or_approval, current_contract, product_gap, trust_or_prelaunch, no_response, no_fit_today
owner_user_id is required - a nurture record with no owner never comes back

errorCases.when: a no-fit record is entered with no specific future change that could create fit. SOP §47 does not permit it.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
